title: DGM technical evidence
observation: DGM v3 reports agent-code improvement while foundation models and outer selection remain fixed.
limitation: Coding-agent experiments, selection and resource budgets do not establish unrestricted successor-model improvement.

title: DGM author explanation and transfer
observation: The DGM authors describe agent-code evolution and transfer experiments.
limitation: An author account complements the paper; it is not independent replication.

title: AlphaEvolve original result
observation: DeepMind reports algorithm discovery and infrastructure optimization with AlphaEvolve.
limitation: Provider-reported bounded outcomes do not establish general intelligence or customer ROI.

title: AlphaEvolve follow-up
observation: The AlphaEvolve follow-up reports additional optimization applications.
limitation: Follow-up deployment reports retain workload and evaluation boundaries.

title: Current frontier-lab RSI account
observation: Anthropic distinguishes current AI research acceleration from fully autonomous successor development.
limitation: Access-dated provider account; activity and proxy gains are not accepted value or general RSI.

title: AGI levels
observation: Levels of AGI separates performance, generality and autonomy.
limitation: A proposed framework, not universal consensus or certification of a system.

title: New AGI measurement framework
observation: The cognitive framework proposes broader ability measurement and human baselines.
limitation: A measurement proposal is not a result showing that a model passed it.

title: Initial productivity RCT
observation: METR reports a slowdown for experienced developers in its early-2025 randomized study.
limitation: The population, tasks and date bound the result; read the later update alongside it.

title: Productivity update and uncertainty
observation: METR reports changed conditions and selection uncertainty in its 2026 productivity update.
limitation: Neither update nor original study supports a timeless universal productivity effect.

title: Task horizons
observation: METR measures success probabilities against tasks characterized by human completion time.
limitation: A 50% horizon is not reliable autonomous work for that many wall-clock hours; task-suite and measurement limits matter.

title: Influential ASI forecast
observation: Altman presents a superintelligence forecast and related scenarios.
limitation: Attributed forecast, not a reproduced ASI observation or a company promise in this paper.

title: Explicit powerful-AI scenario
observation: Amodei defines a powerful-AI scenario and discusses physical and institutional constraints.
limitation: The scenario is not silently relabeled ASI, an arrival observation, or a guaranteed date.

title: OSI definition
observation: OSAID 1.0 specifies freedoms and artifacts beyond downloadable weights.
limitation: OSI definition, not a statute; data information does not mean every original training example.

title: Definition release date
observation: OSI announced version 1.0 of its AI definition in October 2024.
limitation: Release provenance does not demonstrate artifact conformance or universal agreement.

title: Llama restrictions
observation: The pinned Llama 4 license contains a large-user threshold and incorporates an acceptable-use policy.
limitation: Custom license; no full legal applicability, acceptable-use-policy or OSAID audit is asserted.

title: Frontier lab also releases open weights
observation: OpenAI describes gpt-oss weights released under Apache 2.0.
limitation: This establishes overlap between frontier-lab origin and open weights, not full training reproducibility or universal performance.

title: Fuller openness example
observation: Ai2 describes broader lifecycle artifacts for Olmo 3.
limitation: Provider-described availability; no independent complete training reproduction or conformance audit is asserted.

title: Anthropic draft submission
observation: Anthropic announced confidential draft S-1 submission on June 1, 2026.
limitation: The announcement does not establish later filing, effectiveness, pricing or listing; the confidential draft was not inspected.

title: OpenAI draft submission
observation: OpenAI announced June 8, 2026 that it had recently submitted a confidential S-1.
limitation: The exact submission day and final timetable are not established by this announcement.

title: Submission versus filing
observation: The SEC FAQ distinguishes nonpublic draft submission from a filed registration statement.
limitation: General procedural guidance does not establish any particular issuer’s current stage.

title: Anthropic's actual open-weights stance
observation: Anthropic’s July statement rejects a blanket open-weights ban while proposing other controls.
limitation: What the company said is distinct from its motives, every historical action or proven policy effects.

title: Already-public Alphabet
observation: Alphabet’s public-company record establishes parent-company equity status.
limitation: It does not establish a separate AI-lab IPO or AI-segment profitability.

title: Already-public Microsoft
observation: Microsoft’s investor materials establish public parent-company equity.
limitation: It does not establish a separate AI-lab IPO or segment profitability; not every linked filing was retrieved.

title: Already-public Meta
observation: Meta’s investor materials establish public parent-company equity.
limitation: Parent status does not establish separate lab financing or AI-segment profitability.

title: xAI ownership
observation: xAI announced its acquisition by SpaceX on February 2, 2026.
limitation: An acquisition announcement alone is not a listing event.

title: SpaceX listing, unlike a confidential draft
observation: Nasdaq records SpaceX’s June 12, 2026 IPO launch event.
limitation: A diversified parent listing is not a standalone xAI IPO or evidence of AI profitability.

title: HUMMBL homepage
observation: The HUMMBL homepage qualifies its browser demonstration, package maturity and shared-key receipt assurances.
limitation: Observation of public wording, not independent certification of enforcement or production suitability.

title: HUMMBL landing claims
observation: The public landing claim ledger binds individual statements to dated source scopes and assurance limits.
limitation: Publisher classifications and hashes do not independently prove semantic truth or complete mediation.

title: HUMMBL services
observation: The services page offers the $400, 30-minute Bridge Method Diagnostic with preparation and separately scoped engagements. Its process copy uses broad receipt-proof language.
limitation: Prices do not prove sales. Later integration and identity qualifications remain relevant; the correction map addresses the broader wording.

title: HUMMBL build guide
observation: The build page describes composable primitives and deployment responsibilities for route coverage, identity, storage and response.
limitation: A library cannot guarantee that every action is routed through it.

title: HUMMBL models catalog
observation: The public models page presents the Base120 operator catalog.
limitation: Catalog availability does not establish framework superiority or outcome improvement.

title: GPT-6 Astra release
observation: OpenAI’s September Astra release reports results with benchmark-version and research-configuration distinctions.
limitation: Provider report; harness, effort and safeguards matter. No independent rerun or zero-deployment-risk conclusion is asserted.

title: Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 release
observation: Anthropic describes Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 as the same underlying model with different safeguards and access.
limitation: Provider description; delivered permissions and refusals differ from raw model capability.

title: Open Weights and American AI Leadership
observation: The July industry letter advocates open-weights benefits while acknowledging release risks.
limitation: Policy advocacy is not causal proof of universal security or cost advantages.
